Follow up on Run skill: Data modeling
jobs.payload:
Invoked by @cos on 2026-11-09T01:00:51Z. Follow the steps below.

When the human asks you to TRACK something — investors, clients, projects, candidates, deliverables — that is structured data. Build the model with the data_* tools; do not keep it in prose, and do not reach for an app unless they ask for one.

1. Call data_list_spaces, then data_get_schema on the space that fits. One space per use case. If none fits, data_create_space — it is private to you and the human by default.
2. Check the existing types before creating. If a type already exists, add to it with data_add_attributes; never create a second near-duplicate type.
3. Create the types, their attributes AND the relationships between them in ONE data_create_object_types call. A relationship IS an attribute: type=relationship plus `relationship` also creates the mirrored attribute on the other type. State cardinality from the side you are defining, because it cannot be changed later.
4. Re-read the schema right after any create or change: the store adds a required primary `name` attribute you did not define and mints your select option ids, so your own call is NOT the effective schema. Never invent an attribute slug or an option value — an invalid option comes back listing the valid ones. Never add a near-duplicate option; map onto the existing one or ask.
5. Write records with data_upsert_records on a UNIQUE attribute whenever the source could be read again, so a second run updates instead of duplicating. Every write returns {succeeded, failed, summary, entries[]} in request order — read `entries`, do not assume the whole call worked.
6. Deleting is two calls: data_delete_preview, show the human the impact counts, then data_delete with the token. Sharing is the human's call: a space goes shared or global only when they ask.

jobs.label: Follow up on SMB renewal-retention: go/no-go package
jobs.payload:
I need a decision-ready package on entering the SMB segment with our renewal-retention offer.

Goal: decide by next Monday whether we pitch SMB (10-50 seats), and hand the team everything needed to execute if we do.

Deliverables (all in the team wiki):
1. Research brief at team/research/smb-retention-2026q4.md - market size sanity check, 3 pricing bands, 2 named competitors and how each positions retention, and a section "What we don't know" listing every assumption with how to verify it.
2. Reusable playbook at team/playbooks/smb-renewal-outreach.md - ICP, a 5-step outreach motion, the three objections we should expect with answers, and a one-page checklist an AE can execute without asking questions.
3. One outreach email at team/emails/smb-renewal-intro.md, under 180 words, written for a 20-seat SaaS company whose renewal is 60 days out.
4. One HTML visual artifact that puts the go/no-go recommendation on a single screen.

Success criteria:
- All four deliverables exist at those paths and are readable in the team wiki.
- Every number is either sourced (name the source) or marked unknown; no invented statistics.
- The recommendation states a clear go or no-go, the single biggest risk, and what evidence would change the answer.
- You tell me the links in this conversation when done.

Constraints: do not send any email. Do not ask me to approve individual files - use the team. If something is genuinely undecidable, ask me once, in one message, with options.

分解完成 5 条子线并行开工：ST-1 @analyst JOURN-78 研究简报；ST-2 @ae JOURN-81 playbook；ST-3 @ae JOURN-85 邮件样例；ST-4 @cos JOURN-89 go/no-go 单屏 HTML（等前三条结论）；ST-5 @reviewer JOURN-95 四交付物证据 QA。父任务保持 running，由我聚合，全部子任务 lands 后再关父任务。
